what: Four thin sine wave lines (wavelength 536·480px, thickness .5·2·1·1px) flow one wavelength per 6 seconds (360 frames) in opposite directions. Each line’s amplitude rises and falls between .22 and 1x on its own track, and its opacity breathes between .3 and 1. A calm wave laid under the big title. The canvas is not stretched, so line size stays the same on phones

options.scale: Image scale, default 1 (not stretched like the original)
options.shift-y: Px to push the line group down, default 0 (group center sits at 228px on the board)

note: The original embeds a createjs movie clip exported from Adobe Animate (wave-line.html) in an iframe. Here the line shape and the per-frame x, scaleY and alpha are rebuilt on the same createjs Stage and Ticker with the original values (31 points sampled every 12 frames, straight lines in between). Frames pause when off screen.
